messages.text:
"I want to make game. A mobile action role-playing game is an engaging form of entertainment that combines fast-paced combat, character collection, strategic team-building, and long-term character development. One of its most distinctive features is the ability to collect a wide variety of playable characters, each with unique appearances, personalities, abilities, and combat styles. Players can obtain their favorite characters, develop their individual strengths, and create their own teams based on their preferences and strategic goals. The game allows players to experience a diverse range of combat abilities, including powerful energy attacks, close-range physical combat, magical skills, and special techniques. Each character possesses a unique set of skills that can be activated during real-time battles, allowing players to directly control their movements, select appropriate abilities, and respond to enemy attacks. The combat system emphasizes both action and strategy, as players must carefully manage skill cooldowns, understand enemy attack patterns, and determine the most effective way to defeat their opponents. In addition, players can form teams consisting of multiple characters, and the combination of different abilities, character types, and leadership effects can significantly influence the outcome of a battle. This team-building system encourages players to experiment with different combinations and develop strategies suited to various challenges. Another important feature is the extensive character progression system. Players can strengthen their characters by increasing their levels, enhancing their equipment, upgrading their skills, and unlocking advanced abilities. As characters become stronger, they gain access to more powerful attacks and improved combat performance, allowing them to participate in increasingly difficult missions. The game also offers various customization options, including alternative outfits that change a character's appearance and may introduce new abilities, animations, or combat effects. These customization features allow players to personalize their characters while exploring different versions of familiar heroes and villains. In addition to character development, the game provides a variety of content designed to maintain long-term engagement. Story missions allow players to follow an original narrative, discover new environments, and complete objectives while progressing through the game. Special mission-based quests offer additional challenges and valuable rewards, while boss battles require players to develop powerful characters and carefully execute their strategies against formidable enemies. Competitive game modes allow players to test their teams against other players, creating an additional layer of strategic depth. Some activities also encourage cooperation and interaction through alliances, shared objectives, and group-based challenges. The game features colorful three-dimensional graphics, detailed character models, dynamic animations, and impressive visual effects that make battles feel exciting and immersive. Its intuitive touch controls and virtual joystick allow players to move their characters and activate skills conveniently on mobile devices. Although the basic controls are relatively easy to learn, the extensive character roster, diverse combat mechanics, and challenging missions provide considerable depth for experienced players. Furthermore, regular updates introduce new characters, missions, events, and gameplay improvements, ensuring that players have new content to explore. The free-to-play model allows users to access the game without an initial purchase, while optional in-game purchases provide additional ways to obtain certain items and resources. Overall, this type of mobile action RPG offers a rich and immersive gaming experience by combining character collection, real-time combat, strategic decision-making, customization, and continuous progression.

This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
